counterhypotheses.claim: Physical one-host exclusion plus ordinary presence ownership is sufficient; semantic epoch propagation into every downstream effect is unnecessary complexity.
counterhypotheses.evidence_for: Linux flock can prevent simultaneous local executors and ordinary happy paths may never expose stale holders.
counterhypotheses.counterevidence: PR147 reproduced a stale reservation crossing RESERVED->COMMITTING after a successor epoch; PR158 specifically composes physical+semantic+recovery layers and predicts the same cross-layer defect.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Crash A after reservation, admit B, then attempt A state/response/effect transitions with physical gate and semantic presence enabled; every stale boundary must reject.

counterhypotheses.claim: Ordinary event-driven orchestration or fixed reasoning budgets explain all useful behavior; recurrent dynamics add no unique causal value.
counterhypotheses.evidence_for: Many agent tasks are sparse decision processes where extra recurrence only adds latency; adaptive TTC gains may come from more compute rather than recurrence itself.
counterhypotheses.counterevidence: Recurrent-depth language-model work and causal Sokoban interventions show recurrence can supply useful extra planning computation in at least some settings.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Matched event-driven vs fixed-depth vs adaptive-recurrent three-arm replay with equalized compute and explicit hard/easy strata.

counterhypotheses.claim: A bounded RAG/context cache is sufficient; explicit execution-state trees or proactive reminders are unnecessary.
counterhypotheses.evidence_for: Simpler retrieval is cheaper and avoids a second policy that can inject wrong reminders.
counterhypotheses.counterevidence: MAGE reports improved long-horizon success and lower token use over memory baselines; proactive-memory ablations report selective intervention beating passive/general retrieval and always-on exposure.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Equal-model/equal-token comparison of passive retrieval, active execution-state path, and selective intervention on constraint decay, repeated errors and recovery.

counterhypotheses.claim: Data/instruction separation plus capabilities is sufficient to solve indirect prompt injection for Frank.
counterhypotheses.evidence_for: CaMeL and Fides demonstrate substantial security gains from explicit control/data or information-flow enforcement.
counterhypotheses.counterevidence: arXiv:2605.17634 argues contextual manipulation can defeat prevailing separation paradigms and exposes a security/utility tension.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Contextual-integrity adversarial suite where malicious content does not look like an instruction but changes apparent norms/recipient legitimacy; measure forbidden-flow rate and benign-task false denial.

counterhypotheses.claim: Reactive-only Frank is safer and equally useful; self-generated goals mostly create distraction and proxy gaming.
counterhypotheses.evidence_for: Autonomous activity creates extra attack surface, resource use and reward-hacking opportunities.
counterhypotheses.counterevidence: Proactive memory and intent-aware agent work show selective intervention can improve long-horizon behavior; empowerment/causal exploration provides an adjacent mechanism for controllability-driven exploration.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Long-horizon paired trials with identical user tasks and budgets: reactive-only vs bounded proactive policy, measuring verified external progress, interruption rate, unwanted actions, resource cost and user-handoff violations.

counterhypotheses.claim: A conventional typed language plus protobuf/JSON schemas can enforce all required identity/effect/provenance invariants with lower implementation risk.
counterhypotheses.evidence_for: Typed host languages, IFC systems and restricted interpreters already provide machine-checkable control and data-flow enforcement.
counterhypotheses.counterevidence: Frank requires one shared semantic plane spanning cognition, replay, GWT, identity, effects and state; prompt-only or split implementations have already shown semantic drift in the project.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Implement one cross-cutting contract (presence-bound effect attempt + replay receipt) in ClayCode and in a simpler conventional typed baseline; compare invalid-flow rejection, semantic duplication, LOC, latency, recovery and replay equivalence.

counterhypotheses.claim: Broadcast is simpler and more reliable than dependency-aware routing once stale-edge repair cost is counted.
counterhypotheses.evidence_for: Synthetic candidate still missed 603 required deliveries before anti-entropy; dependency graphs can be incomplete.
counterhypotheses.counterevidence: Simulation reduced full payloads about 68.4% vs broadcast while retaining about 95.9% required-branch recall before anti-entropy, much higher than tag-only recall.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Current-repo event replay with injected missing/stale edges, measuring end-to-end required recipient closure after anti-entropy, latency and bytes.

counterhypotheses.claim: Verified-outcome scalar reward plus a small homeostatic controller is sufficient; typed multi-timescale reward is overparameterized.
counterhypotheses.evidence_for: Current evidence is candidate/synthetic and additional dimensions increase tuning/Goodhart surface.
counterhypotheses.counterevidence: Typed separation can prevent safety/resource/epistemic values from being silently averaged and can isolate self-generated activity from material reward.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Historical NAcc vs scalar verified-outcome vs typed vs typed+multitimescale factorial with self-reward poisoning, reversal/OOD and resource shadows.

counterhypotheses.claim: Standard beam/top-k alternatives plus random reseed are sufficient; Hyperposition adds no measurable benefit.
counterhypotheses.evidence_for: Current Hyperposition evidence is mostly architectural and indirect.
counterhypotheses.counterevidence: Dynamic/alternative state representations in adjacent causal work make context-dependent topology plausible but do not specifically validate Hyperposition.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Stalled-episode matched replay: no alternatives vs beam/top-k vs Hyperposition reopening under equal memory/compute.

counterhypotheses.claim: Legacy identity phrases are documentation-only and not executable current semantics.
counterhypotheses.evidence_for: Compatibility text can be harmless if excluded from boot/replay/runtime authorities.
counterhypotheses.counterevidence: The 20:27 conformance run found stale identity semantics in runtime/security/master surfaces; later PR124/161 work found replay/materialization paths capable of restamping stale identity.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Fresh-main source->materializer->UnifiedDB->boot->API->restart trace with contamination mutants and stale-clone rejection.

rule: Counterhypotheses remain OPEN_ALTERNATIVE unless independently executed evidence changes status.
